tagline: Inside the Machine. Before It Breaks.
anti_clone_note: 100% original en-US adult engineering identity (FailSafe Lab / @FailSafeLab) using deep-blueprint 2.5D projected CAD cutaways, machined steel/brass shading, industrial amber/cyan telemetry, and the authoritative Charon baritone voice — zero overlap with sister survival-storytelling channels, template defaults, or stick-figure What-If channels.

visual_style.style_decision_rationale: Selected after /reel-watch audit of DYYsGuTpBKc (Possiblo) and M_t2ZUz7_pc (Iflord). Both references achieve their peak explanatory retention during deep-navy volumetric spotlight cutaways, rim-lit silhouettes, dotted measurement arcs, live comparison bars, and dark-surface yellow pill HUD chips — while their stick-silhouette characters suit lifestyle What-If comedy rather than adult STEM engineering. Programmatic 2.5D projected isometric CAD vector animation in Pillow + NumPy piped to ffmpeg captures that exact dark-stage telemetry magnetism with machined steel/brass bevels, force vectors, and stress heatmaps, runs cleanly at 16-23 fps on 2 CPU cores, avoids clone overlap, and keeps youtube_ai_disclosure_stylized_2d accurately false.

reference_takeaways.DYYsGuTpBKc: Adopt deep-navy overhead volumetric spotlight cutaways, isometric glowing volumes, dark pill yellow HUD badges, and bold white/yellow outlined headlines; omit stick-figure narrative characters.
reference_takeaways.M_t2ZUz7_pc: Adopt peak-tension frozen metallic Frame 0 framing, warm directional rim-lighting, dotted circular callout arcs, and live comparison bar charts; omit mid-video comment popups and subscribe prompts for 65-80s Shorts.

narration.style_direction: Authoritative, crisp American English engineering narrator. Fast documentary cadence (1.02x to 1.06x), clean articulation on numbers and mechanical terms, tight dramatic beats before reveals, controlled lowered half-voice tension with clean vocal clarity.

retention_rules.frame_0_hook: Full-frame peak-tension 2.5D macro cutaway frozen at critical mechanical load + bold two-tone white/yellow outlined top hook text inside y=260..460, x=90..990 + immediate spoken hook at t=0.0s (zero fade-in, zero empty wide shot, zero HUD callout clutter on Beat 1).
retention_rules.ending_cta: Low-friction 1-word or 1-number comment prompt tied directly to the engineering scenario (e.g., Comment YES or NO).
